mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_payment_log( id, order_number, payment_type, transaction_id, trade_type, trade_state, bank_type, success_time, payer_openid, total, service_fee_rate, service_fee, content, deleted ) VALUES ( null, #{orderNumber}, #{paymentType}, #{transactionId}, #{tradeType}, #{tradeState}, #{bankType}, #{successTime}, #{payerOpenid}, #{total}, #{serviceFeeRate}, #{serviceFee}, #{content}, #{deleted} )
